headline: Bessent: We can grow our way out of debt with 3% GDP growth

US2Y.source: Federal Reserve daily yield via GuruFocus

learning_profile.note: ACTIONABLE v2 segment for mixed_neutral confidence 1-4 at next_session supports a modest confidence increase for the neutral next-session view; current macro/context remains primary.

predictions.mechanism: A 3% growth objective is mildly supportive for earnings, but the statement contains no new policy action and is offset by elevated Treasury yields, firm DXY and oil near $100.
predictions.invalidation: A concrete fiscal-spending restraint plan plus falling yields would turn the balance more positive; another yield/oil spike would turn it negative.

predictions.mechanism: Growth optimism is supportive, but high long yields remain a direct valuation headwind for duration-sensitive technology stocks.
predictions.invalidation: A sustained fall in US10Y with unchanged growth expectations would shift the signal upward; a renewed yield surge would shift it downward.

predictions.mechanism: Stronger nominal growth can help cyclicals, but debt sustainability rhetoric without concrete spending action is insufficient to offset elevated energy and rate pressure.
predictions.invalidation: Concrete deficit restraint with easing energy and yields would improve the outlook; worsening fiscal concerns would weaken it.
